notes.title: Performance Update - New City Design
notes.content:
New Patch is Here!


There were reports of performance issues with "Storage Hustle" and we decided to make the city from scratch and make it more compact and optimised the game mechanics overall hoping that it will solve most of these issues.  Give it a go and please report to us from our Discord server if your game is still having problems. Thanks for your patience.

Our road map for Storage Hustle is on the way too, I'm sorry if we prolong things but this project is our first one and there were responsibilities we weren't aware of from the get go. We hope you understand us and thank you all for your support. 

STORAGE HUSTLE WILL RETURN

(and be released to full)

 Have a great Christmas y'all 🎅


Broken Clock Team's Games

notes.title: New Games Announcement!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are excited to announce our new games. Check them out below 👇


Print money, buy and upgrade money printing machines, expand, repeat and get rich. Here's Money Print Factory Tycoon 3D.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166120/Money_Print_Factory_3D_Tycoon?utm_source=SHAnnouncement1

notes.title: 🔥🔥HUGE UPDATE🔥🔥Read details 👉👉
notes.content:
📣📣Hey everyone!! The newest update is here! We present you:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642128/1ad56589bca1d9f8763defebb94911f3919b5e28.jpg
🎪🎪Fiesta Hustle is a carnaval with hard games and unique prizes. You can earn tickets by showing your skills on these carnaval games. Here is some of the games:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642128/71ef0c163aeebadb5c70e1c2dcb383d4621e2aa5.jpg
🏆🏆The prizes are unique, valuable and exciting. We offer over 10+ new items and 3 brand new, smoking hot vehicles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642128/deb14f15a309f4c75bc705fc8f857103dcd29a59.jpg

Also there was new additions we didn't properly announce.

🔸+25 New Items - Tomahawks, Demon Masks, Voodoo Dolls and many more!
🔸Steam Achievements - Over 30 achievements is ready to be earned. 
🔸Steam Community Items - What's better than gaining cool items from auctions in Storage Hustle? Gaining community items of Storage Hustle in real life! Badges, Trading Cards, Backgrounds, Emoticons. You can submit your artwork or suggestions to us through Discord or e-mail.
🔸Italian language added 🍕 Mamma mia!
🔸Display Cases🖼️ - You got nowhere to put your beloved legendary items? You just want to show off your belongings? Worry no more. With these display cases you can put your trophies and name them of your liking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642128/eff790a0539a8bc64f22b8b31c97852b6ec5240a.jpg

🗺️ROAD MAP🗺️

-Features We Want To Add-

🔹Smashable Crates and Picklock

🔹Better Environment Design
🔹Pawn Shop you can own
🔹Controller Support
🔹Steam Deck Support

We are sorry for the long wait. We had to take some time off and tend to personal matters. We hope you'll enjoy what we've been working on.

Also there is a bug/mistake in achievements, sometimes players can't earn them. We are working on it right now. Thanks for your patience.

🙏You can support us by leaving a review on Steam. It helps us a lot.

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE - We've been cooking!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642128/98a61be7a32a9fe6108633e502d1f9a55d93f934.jpg

NEW STORAGE ZONE WITH CARS!!

- Test your luck and see if you can find a car in the "Sinner Santa Storage"
- 60 new exciting items for you to discover
- This is a high risk high reward area, let's see if you can hit the jackpot!

New Features

- You can sell your cars in your House's garden now!
- Character walking animation and sounds.
- Tools now have a finishing effect and their sound is improved
- New NPCs around the city which soon will be joining us in auctions.

Fixes and Changes

- Haggle is a bit more challenging now, and customer AI is improved.
- More items on Yard Sales and Prices are different and changing
- "Fix Car" button works different now, due to addition of new cars.
- Economy design changed. Harder to earn money now.
- Some localization changes.

Upcoming Features

These are things we want to add to game if we can continue developing, you can support us by giving us feedbacks or bugs on Discord or leaving a review on Steam! Thanks to everybody that supported/supports us!

- New vehicles in Auto Gallery
- New NPCs in Auctions
- A Pawn Shop of your own, with customers coming in to buy your items or sell their items.
- Controller Support
- Cloud Save
- Some items will have interaction, for example a gameboy has a playable minigame or you can open a song in a boombox.
- Environment Design
- Car Modification
- Steam Achievements
- Item Quests/Detailed repair on some items

notes.title: Patch #6 Hotfix V0.2.7
notes.content:
-This patch has a bigger size because we couldn't update the game with small sized patches. We had to re-upload the game everytime due to it being compressed. After this patch, our upcoming updates will be smaller in size.-


 Economy balance changes.
 Foreign language fonts updated.
 Exit warnings added.
 Settings panel changes - mouse and camera sensitivity, VSync etc.
 Hammer now increases conditions in one hit.

 Bug Fixes - We fixed LOTS OF bugs, but these were the most problematic ones.

 Infinite Sell bug is gone, we can sleep now...
 Some items said "Far From Home" even though they are not. Not anymore.
 When you sold an item that's inside a box, the box wouldn't move.
 Some naughty cars in the city would go outside the city borders. We fixed that.


We are also working on new features currently. We will make a new announcement soon!
